sources.title: Affine (SN120) — Reasoning Model Competition | Bittensor.ai
sources.snippet: Register a Bittensor hotkey on Subnet 120, create a HuggingFace account with a write token, then pull a baseline model from the network with `af pull <UID>`. Improve it through training or fine-tuning, upload to HuggingFace in a repo named with your hotkey suffix, and run `af miner-deploy` to commit the model revision on-chain.
